mapper.select: SELECT id, name, host, region, protocol, capacity, active_client_count, status, created_at FROM vpn_nodes ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, host, region, protocol, capacity, active_client_count, status, created_at FROM vpn_nodes WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_nodes (name, host, region, protocol, capacity, active_client_count, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{host}, #{region}, #{protocol}, #{capacity}, 0, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE vpn_nodes SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vpn_nodes SET active_client_count = active_client_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_client_count < capacity
